newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa flies carparts to/from Spain.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa flies carparts to/from Spain.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo AG said it has flown two special freighter charter flights from Spain and Portugal to Germany due to the 12-day Spanish truckers' strike.
The all-cargo airline said the flights carried automotive parts for German car manufacturers.

Lufthansa Cargo spokesman Dietrich Seidl said a Douglas DC8F was chartered to fly between Frankfurt and Oporto on Saturday February 15 and a Boeing 737F flew one-way from Seville to Cologne on Sunday February 16.
But he noted: "This is relatively little and does not represent a great deal of extra business."

It appeared that the strike was preventing freight being carried out of production centres to airports and thus limiting how much could be switched to air transport from the normal lorry haulage, he added.
HeavyLift Cargo Airlines said earlier it had carried 1,000 tonnes of cargo on a dozen flights out of Spain, with departures split almost evenly between Germany and Britain.
